title: MAVLink command acknowledgement
description: Published BY bridges/mavlink_command_bridge.py to {TOPIC_ROOT}/air/mavlink/ack/{entity_id} in reply to a command on the matching .../cmd/{entity_id} topic. See mavlink_command.schema.json for the request.

cmd.description: Echo of the request's cmd field. null only when the request itself wasn't valid JSON.

result.description: One of MAVLink's own MAV_RESULT enum names (e.g. ACCEPTED, DENIED, FAILED) on a real ack, or one of this bridge's own out-of-band results: REJECTED (bad JSON or unknown/invalid command, never reached the vehicle) or TIMEOUT (no COMMAND_ACK within 5s).

detail.description: Present only on result=REJECTED — human-readable reason.

_ts.description: Unix epoch seconds, set by the bridge at publish time.
